♦️ **FLEX GUI PRO V9.3.0 ETUUSE! (AFTER EFFECTS)**

**MAP RIGS 2.0**, AutoCaptions nga erina **Your script** ne **Gemini 3.5 Transcribe**, ne **Flex Studio (Beta)** esooka okuwanulibwa n'ekubuuza nga tennaba kuteekebwa ku kompyuta.

*(Gissa ku nkyusa gy'olina kati, oddemu otandike After Effects omulundi gumu.)*

♦️ **Ekipya: MAP RIGS 2.0**
* Endabika ya **Map desk**, okunoonya ebifo nga tolina yintaneeti, **Quick looks** (Country Pop, Space Dive, Trip Route n'ebirala), Stick to Map, Clean labels, Always Sharp, emisono gya maapu egy'obwereere ne **Open in Flex Maps**.
* Ebikozesebwa byakyo eby'enjawulo (live sync, emisono, labels, 3D, Finalize) kati ddala bitandika munda mu After Effects.

♦️ **Ebipya mu AutoCaptions**
* **Gemini 3.5 Transcribe** (ku cloud, ekozesa credits za Flex AI) ye yingini esinga okuwagirwa, eronderwa omulundi gumu buli muntu. Londa nate Whisper okukola captions ku bwereere ku kompyuta yo (Translate To yeetaaga Whisper). Seeva bw'eba ng'erina emirimu mingi, ekulaga ekifo kyo mu lunyiriri.
* **Your script**: captions zitwala empandiika n'ebigambo bya script yo wonna w'oyogedde ebigambo ebyo.
* Ekifulumizibwa ekya **Editable template**: captions nga layers za template z'osobola okukyusa endabika mu Essential Properties (After Effects 2026).
* Tewali ky'olonze era Source media teriimu kintu? Ekuwa **composition yonna**. Eddoboozi lye limu liddamu okukozesa transcript yaalyo.

♦️ **Flex Studio (Beta)**
* **Download Flex Studio (Beta)** ewanula app, oluvannyuma n'ebuuza **Install / Not now**.
* App (2.0.0-beta.2): ebifo by'okukoleramu **PRO, TRACK, ROTOSCOPE, COLOR GRADING**, ebisumuluzo by'ebikozesebwa bya After Effects, clips ziggulawo mangu ddala, era OPEN ekola ku precomps ne adjustment layers.

♦️ **Ebitereezeddwa**
* Effects za theme ezaali zibula ku kompyuta nnyingi eza Windows zizzeemu (zibeera mpewufu nga animation effects za Windows ziggyiddwako).

♦️ **Ekifo w'oli (si kya buwaze) okukuuma layisinsi**
* Kibuuzibwa omulundi gumu, era si kya buwaze: ne **No thanks** buli kimu kigenda mu maaso nga kikola. Kikyuse mu **Flex Settings > Privacy**. Kikuumibwa emyezi 12, tekitundibwa, era tekigabanibwa n'omuntu yenna okuggyako amateeka bwe gakyetaaga.

ult.message:
♦️ **FLEX ULTIMATE V2.3.0 ETUUSE! (PREMIERE PRO)**

**Caption Stack esengukidde mu AutoCaptions** ng'erina emisono gya buli kigambo, layouts, entambula n'amaloboozi. **UN-NEST** ne blend modes bikola ku Premiere 26.5, **AUTO CUT** kunyiga omulundi gumu, ate **Flex Studio (Beta)** eggulawo clip yo okuva ku panel.

*(Gissa ku nkyusa gy'olina kati, oddemu otandike Premiere Pro omulundi gumu.)*

♦️ **Ekipya: Captions ezitambula mu AutoCaptions**
* **Omusono gw'ekigambo**: wa buli kigambo langi zaakyo, font yaakyo n'okumaliriza kwa Flat, Shine oba Glow.
* **Layouts z'olunyiriri**: Stack, Over, Under, Beside ne Line.
* **Entambula ya buli kigambo** (Fade, Pop, Rise, Type, Shake n'endala) ng'erina preview, wamu n'amaloboozi **Pop / Tick / Swoosh**. Emisono gy'ebigambo n'entambula byetaaga ekifulumizibwa kya **Images**.
* **Gemini 3.5 Transcribe** (ku cloud, ekozesa credits za Flex AI) kati ye yingini esinga okuwagirwa, eronderwa omulundi gumu buli muntu; londa yingini ya Whisper okukola captions nga tolina yintaneeti era ku bwereere.
* **Your script** (Captions mode): captions zitwala ebigambo bya script yo w'oyogedde ebigambo ebyo.
* Bw'oba tolonze kintu (Source card nga njereere), ekuwa **timeline yonna**; captions ziterekebwa kumpi ne pulojekiti yo.

♦️ **Ekipya: Flex Studio (Beta)**
* **Open in Flex Studio** egoberera clip mu app; **APPLY TO PREMIERE** ezzaayo track. Tennaba kuteekebwa? **Download Flex Studio (Beta)** egiwanula, oluvannyuma n'ebuuza **Install / Not now**.

♦️ **Ebikyusiddwa**
* **AUTO CUT** yeekenneenya clip gy'olonze n'esala mu kunyiga okumu. **Retakes** ekwata ennyiriri ezaddibwamu okutandikibwa.
* **Audio Studio** kati erina sub-tabs mukaaga. **Library** kati eri mu Nest Saver.

♦️ **Ebitereezeddwa**
* **UN-NEST** ku Premiere 26.5 (yali egaana buli nest), ne blend modes nga Screen ezaali zidda ku Normal (Premiere mu Lungereza).
* Akabonero akamyufu **AUTOSAVE 0:00**, preview ya Caption Stack eyali enzirugavu, n'effects za theme ezaali zibula ku kompyuta nnyingi eza Windows.

♦️ **Ekifo w'oli (si kya buwaze) okukuuma layisinsi**
* Kibuuzibwa omulundi gumu, era si kya buwaze: ne **No thanks** buli kimu kigenda mu maaso nga kikola. Kikyuse mu **Flex Settings > Privacy**. Kikuumibwa emyezi 12, tekitundibwa, era tekigabanibwa n'omuntu yenna okuggyako amateeka bwe gakyetaaga.
